forecast.name: Iron forecast
forecast.about: The DOTS we expect at the lifter's next meet, and how lifters do against it.

rt: The DOTS we expect at the lifter's next meet (our forecast, as of today).
dots: The best DOTS score in the window: total adjusted for bodyweight (Konertz 2019). Year to year it repeats at r = 0.93; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.93.
gl: The best IPF GL (Goodlift) points in the window, the IPF's own bodyweight formula. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.96; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.86.
wilks: The best Wilks score in the window (the older bodyweight formula, still used by some federations).
total: The heaviest full-power total in the window. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.97; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.68.
squat: The heaviest squat in a full-power meet in the window. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.96; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.68.
bench: The heaviest bench press in a full-power meet in the window. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.96; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.63.
dead: The heaviest deadlift in a full-power meet in the window. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.97; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.68.
rel: Best total divided by bodyweight on the day. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.95; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.81.
rel_s: Squat at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.93; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.82.
rel_b: Bench at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.94; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.75.
rel_d: Deadlift at the best-total meet divided by bodyweight. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.94; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.75.
sh_s: The squat as a share of the best total: a style, not better or worse. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.78; with next year's best DOTS, r = -0.00.
sh_b: The bench as a share of the best total: a style. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.83; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.23.
sh_d: The deadlift as a share of the best total: a style. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.84; with next year's best DOTS, r = -0.18.
make: Share of attempts made, all three lifts, shrunk toward the stream average (as if nine more attempts at the average).
third: Share of third attempts made (shrunk toward the average with six attempts).
jump3: The average jump from a made second attempt to the third, as a share of the second: bold or careful, a style.
beat: Share of meets above our pre-meet expectation (shrunk toward half with four meets). Year to year it repeats at r = 0.18; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.12.
value: Average DOTS above our pre-meet expectation per meet (shrunk toward zero with three meets). Year to year it repeats at r = 0.18; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.14.
cons: How far each meet lands from the lifter's own trend line, in DOTS (shrunk). Lower is steadier. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.20; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.10.
bomb: Share of full-power meets without a total (shrunk toward the stream rate with five meets). Year to year it repeats at r = 0.80; with next year's best DOTS, r = -0.23.
prog: The trend in DOTS per year over the window (shrunk toward zero for a short span). Year to year it repeats at r = 0.13; with next year's best DOTS, r = 0.13.
meets: Scored full-power meets in the window. Year to year it repeats at r = 0.49; with next year's best DOTS, r = -0.09.
